'This gets +1{d} while defending a weapon attack. / Guardwell'

Identical text to .drafts/blade_beckoner_helm (Head) and .drafts/blade_beckoner_boots (Legs); this is the Chest printing - same shape, copied from shipped pen/basalt_boots.json.

Guardwell is a printed keyword (printed_keywords, verified in slug_index: keywords ['Guardwell']) and fires from the card DB keywords field (ability_keywords.guardwell) - deliberately NOT authored here; authoring it again would be a defect.

The +1{d} clause: WHILE_STATIC naming trigger RECALC_DEFENSE + MODIFY_DEFENSE. DEVIATION FROM TRIAGE: the triage list named STATIC_TRIGGERED, but the shipped corpus spells defence statics as WHILE_STATIC with an explicit trigger - interpreter.dispatch_event (interpreter.py:186-201) routes WHILE_STATIC to RECALC_DEFENSE when named, and a plain STATIC_TRIGGERED on RECALC_DEFENSE would also fire, but every shipped defence static (basalt_boots, blackstone_greaves, stacked_in_your_favor_red, ...) uses the WHILE_STATIC form, so consistency wins. engine._recalculate_total_defense (engine.py:1983-2054) resets each declared defender to its base {d}, then dispatches RECALC_DEFENSE once per defender to [that defender] + the attack card + both heroes + all permanents/head/chest/arms/legs/weapon zones of BOTH players (engine.py:2016-2031) - chest is in that list, so this equipment receives the dispatch when it defends. Naming the trigger matters: without it the static defaults to RECALC_ATTACK_POWER, where combat.defense_recalc_card is None and MODIFY_DEFENSE falls back to its source card (interpreter.py:186-201).

IS_DEFENDING_CARD scopes the effect to the defender currently being evaluated (combat.defense_recalc_card is this card; condition_types.py:536-599, self-only variant confirmed at line 550); without it the once-per-defender dispatch would let this static add +1{d} to every other defending card in turn. MODIFY_DEFENSE writes the defender card's own {d} (effect_types.py:2614-2650, reads amount/mod), which survives into total_defense; because each pass resets to base first, the static cannot stack across recalculations.

ATTACK_IS_WEAPON reads combat.from_weapon (condition_types.py:198-199), stamped from attack_card.is_weapon when the CombatState is created (engine.py:527) and consulted at defense-recalc time. That is exactly the release-note-free reading of 'while defending a weapon attack': the check is on the CURRENT attack being a weapon attack, so the +1{d} holds even if the weapon has since been used on another link or flicked.
